alkylation reagent: alkylated with 55 mM iodoacetamide in 50 mM HEPES.
alkylation concentration: alkylated with 55 mM iodoacetamide in 50 mM HEPES.
cleavage agent: Proteins were digested for 18 to 24 h on bead with sequencing grade trypsin (Promega) in 50 mM HEPES buffer at 1:50 trypsin to protein ratio.
collision energy: Selected ions were HCD fragmented at normalized collision energy 33%.
enrichment method: An acidified sample was added to Fe-NTA spin columns (ThermoFisher Scientific), and phosphopeptide enrichment was performed as previously described.
fragmentation method: Selected ions were HCD fragmented at normalized collision energy 33%.
instrument: Eluates were then subjected to LC-MS/MS on the Q-Exactive Plus as follows
labeling: 5 μg of each sample was lyophilized and labeled with TMTpro isobaric mass tags.
reduction reagent: Denatured reactions were then reduced with 10 mM dithiothreitol (DTT) in 50 mM HEPES (pH 8.5)
reduction concentration: Denatured reactions were then reduced with 10 mM dithiothreitol (DTT) in 50 mM HEPES (pH 8.5)
